info.name: Patrolling API
info.description:
End-to-end collection for the Patrolling backend (Laravel + Sanctum). Two auth tracks: Admin (Next.js panel) and App (Flutter field app) — never interchangeable.

Run order for a clean database:
1. Auth > Admin Login
2. Auth > App Login
3. Admin - Ranges > Update Range (set category, optional)
4. Admin - Patrol Types / Beats / Vehicles as needed
5. App - Lookups (to see dropdown data)
6. App - Patrol Entry Lifecycle, in order (Create -> GPS Ping -> Case Report -> End Patrol)

Seed test accounts (create these once via `php artisan tinker` if not already present):
- Admin: employee_id=`postman_admin`, password=`PostmanAdmin@123`
- App user: employee_id=`postman_user`, password=`PostmanUser@123`, granted access to a range

All IDs (tokens, range_id, beat_id, patrol_type_id, mode_id, entry_id, etc.) are captured automatically into collection variables by each request's test script — just run requests top-to-bottom.

pe_patrol_date must use {{$isoTimestamp}} (today) — Postman's dynamic variable — since the API rejects future dates.
